## Katalon MCP server

These workflows depend on the Katalon MCP server. Add an `mcpServers` entry to your agent's MCP config using the canonical shape in `.mcp.json` at the repo root. It ships the ready-to-use endpoint `https://platform.katalon.io/mcp`; only override the host if you have a dedicated Katalon domain.

```sh
npx -y mcp-remote https://platform.katalon.io/mcp --transport http-first
```

Authentication is a browser/OAuth flow. Never paste passwords, tokens, cookies, JWTs, or callback URLs into chat.

Start with `katalon-platform-setup` to connect and verify the MCP, then use the workflow skills. For human-facing install instructions per agent, see [README.md](https://github.com/katalon-labs/true-skills#install).
